text: 海南希瓦私募基金管理有限责任公司发布公告称，基于对中国资本市场长期健康稳定发展的信心，公司的关联企业上海希瓦私募基金管理中心（有限合伙）和基金经理梁宏及其直系亲属于2026年7月30日使用其自有资金申购希瓦私募旗下梁宏作为基金经理管理的私募基金产品份额共计1040万元。
text_en: Hainan Xiwa Private Fund Management Co., Ltd. announced that, based on confidence in the long-term healthy and stable development of China's capital market, its affiliate Shanghai Xiwa Private Fund Management Center (Limited Partnership) and fund manager Liang Hong and his direct family used their own funds to subscribe a total of RMB 10.4 million in Xiwa private fund products managed by Liang Hong on July 30, 2026.
